page.overview:
Who is Marissa Faireborn?

Marissa Faireborn is a character in the IDW Transformers comics.

Marissa Faireborn got her start in the Season 3 episodes of the Gen 1 Transformers cartoon. In the cartoon she was the daughter of Old Man Flint.

In the Optimus Prime comic series, Marissa Faireborn is the Ex-Head of the Earth Defense Command.

She hangs out with her dog Buster and with Thundercracker, a former Decepticon who has gone native.
